title: Electric Service Agreement Reliability Credit Terms — Amount of the Chronic-Outage Credit
content:
Under the **Electric Service Agreement**, Lakeshore Power & Light Company compensates repeated interruptions at a service address with a chronic-outage credit, on the following terms.

**1. Records counted.** Every outage record at the address counts toward the chronic threshold, whatever its duration, cause or major event day.

**2. Chronic look-back.** The chronic look-back is the 12 calendar months before the posting. Every count over a stated number of calendar months before a posting takes the records dated less than that many whole calendar months before the posting date, so the count takes the outage records at the address that began less than 12 whole calendar months before the posting date.

**3. Chronic threshold.** The chronic threshold is the schedule's chronic outage count threshold.

**4. Amount.** The chronic-outage credit is the schedule's chronic outage credit amount, rounded to the cent; the rounded figure is the credit posted.

**5. No credit below the threshold.** No chronic-outage credit is posted while the count of outage records stays below the chronic threshold. A count equal to the threshold reaches it.

**Worked figures (hypothetical inputs).** Schedule chronic outage count threshold of 5 and chronic outage credit amount of $30.00.

| Outage records at the address in the look-back | Threshold reached | Chronic-outage credit |
|---|---|---|
| 4 | no | none posted |
| 5 | yes | $30.00 |
| 6 | yes | $30.00 |

**Look-back boundary (hypothetical).** A record that began on the boundary day, exactly 12 whole calendar months before the posting date, is not counted; a record that began on the day after the boundary day is counted. With four other records in the look-back, the first case leaves the count at 4 and no credit is posted; the second brings it to 5 and the $30.00 credit is posted.
